## Summary

Recover the original C++ interfaces shared by actor motion, battle parameter loading and model registration. Use the existing actor, attack and resistance records, route animation registration through the native motion binding, and carry typed Ninja model and texture pointers to the callers.

## Validation

- Matches the retail GPOE8P DOL, SHA-1 `0d85744b51d7379efb025a943d0cd5aaae2191a3`, on master `264b89efa2`.
- Coverage and linkage checks pass with all 27,572 functions and 2,295 linked units. Battle table lookup and reload tests, HP and TP reset, quest record swaps, and model-node and archive probes pass.
- The source-quality benchmark removes 431 findings and adds four, with zero flagged labels and zero newly stale retention entries. The four additions are existing dispatch slots and one existing hit-record name on the updated typed paths. All 38 symbol changes follow recovered arguments or owners.
